prose: The Wall Street Journal excerpt indexed by Techmeme says Nvidia leadership is considering a retreat from aggressive AI financing, with upfront customer payments expected to play a larger role. It attributes earlier plans to Jensen Huang and possible further restraint to Colette Kress. The article was inaccessible, so specific deal changes, implementation and effects on chip demand remain unverified.
highlights: Upfront payments are the reported alternative
No particular contract change is verified
